record.bible_text: Then said<WH0559><WTH8804> Solomon<WH08010>, The LORD<WH03068> hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> that he would dwell<WH07931><WTH8800> in the thick darkness<WH06205>.
But I have built<WH01129><WTH8804> an house<WH01004> of habitation<WH02073> for thee, and a place<WH04349> for thy dwelling<WH03427><WTH8800> for ever<WH05769>.

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, who hath with his hands<WH03027> fulfilled<WH04390><WTH8765> <FI>that<Fi> which he spake<WH01696><WTH8765> with his mouth<WH06310> to my father<WH01> David<WH01732>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Since the day<WH03117> that I brought forth<WH03318><WTH8689> my people<WH05971> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> I chose<WH0977><WTH8804> no city<WH05892> among all the tribes<WH07626> of Israel<WH03478> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> an house<WH01004> in, that my name<WH08034> might be there; neither chose<WH0977><WTH8804> I any man<WH0376> to be a ruler<WH05057> over my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>:
But I have chosen<WH0977><WTH8799> Jerusalem<WH03389>, that my name<WH08034> might be there; and have chosen<WH0977><WTH8799> David<WH01732> to be over my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>.
Now it was in the heart<WH03824> of David<WH01732> my father<WH01> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> an house<WH01004> for the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>.

But the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> to David<WH01732> my father<WH01>, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart<WH03824> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> an house<WH01004> for my name<WH08034>, thou didst well<WH02895><WTH8689> in that it was in thine heart<WH03824>:

Notwithstanding<WH07535> thou shalt not build<WH01129><WTH8799> the house<WH01004>; but thy son<WH01121> which shall come forth<WH03318><WTH8802> out of thy loins<WH02504>, he shall build<WH01129><WTH8799> the house<WH01004> for my name<WH08034>.

The LORD<WH03068> therefore hath performed<WH06965><WTH8686> his word<WH01697> that he hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>: for I am risen up<WH06965><WTH8799> in the room of David<WH01732> my father<WH01>, and am set<WH03427><WTH8799> on the throne<WH03678> of Israel<WH03478>, as the LORD<WH03068> promised<WH01696><WTH8765>, and have built<WH01129><WTH8799> the house<WH01004> for the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>.

And in it<WH08033> have I put<WH07760><WTH8799> the ark<WH0727>, wherein <FI>is<Fi> the covenant<WH01285> of the LORD<WH03068>, that he made<WH03772><WTH8804> with the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.<CM>

And he stood<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the altar<WH04196> of the LORD<WH03068> in the presence of all the congregation<WH06951> of Israel<WH03478>, and spread forth<WH06566><WTH8799> his hands<WH03709>:

For Solomon<WH08010> had made<WH06213><WTH8804> a brasen<WH05178> scaffold<WH03595>, of five<WH02568> cubits<WH0520> long<WH0753>, and five<WH02568> cubits<WH0520> broad<WH07341>, and three<WH07969> cubits<WH0520> high<WH06967>, and had set<WH05414><WTH8799> it in the midst<WH08432> of the court<WH05835>: and upon it he stood<WH05975><WTH8799>, and kneeled down<WH01288><WTH8799> upon his knees<WH01290> before all the congregation<WH06951> of Israel<WH03478>, and spread forth<WH06566><WTH8799> his hands<WH03709> toward heaven<WH08064>, <RF>long...: Heb. the length thereof, etc<Rf>

And said<WH0559><WTH8799>, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, <FI>there is<Fi> no God<WH0430> like thee in the heaven<WH08064>, nor in the earth<WH0776>; which keepest<WH08104><WTH8802> covenant<WH01285>, and <FI>shewest<Fi> mercy<WH02617> unto thy servants<WH05650>, that walk<WH01980><WTH8802> before<WH06440> thee with all their hearts<WH03820>:

Thou which hast kept<WH08104><WTH8804> with thy servant<WH05650> David<WH01732> my father<WH01> that which thou hast promised<WH01696><WTH8765> him; and spakest<WH01696><WTH8762> with thy mouth<WH06310>, and hast fulfilled<WH04390><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi>  with thine hand<WH03027>, as <FI>it is<Fi> this day<WH03117>.

Now therefore, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, keep<WH08104><WTH8798> with thy servant<WH05650> David<WH01732> my father<WH01> that which thou hast promised<WH01696><WTH8765> him, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, There shall not fail<WH03772><WTH8735> thee a man<WH0376> in my sight<WH06440> to sit<WH03427><WTH8802> upon the throne<WH03678> of Israel<WH03478>; yet so<WH07535> that thy children<WH01121> take heed<WH08104><WTH8799> to their way<WH01870> to walk<WH03212><WTH8800> in my law<WH08451>, as thou hast walked<WH01980><WTH8804> before<WH06440> me. <RF>There...: Heb. There shall not a man be cut off<Rf>
Now then, O LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, let thy word<WH01697> be verified<WH0539><WTH8735>, which thou hast spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> unto thy servant<WH05650> David<WH01732>.

But will God<WH0430> in very deed<WH0552> dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> with men<WH0120> on the earth<WH0776>? behold, heaven<WH08064> and the heaven<WH08064> of heavens<WH08064> cannot contain<WH03557><WTH8770> thee; how much less this house<WH01004> which I have built<WH01129><WTH8804>!

Have respect<WH06437><WTH8804> therefore to the prayer<WH08605> of thy servant<WH05650>, and to his supplication<WH08467>, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, to hearken<WH08085><WTH8800> unto the cry<WH07440> and the prayer<WH08605> which thy servant<WH05650> prayeth<WH06419><WTH8693> before<WH06440> thee:

That thine eyes<WH05869> may be open<WH06605><WTH8803> upon this house<WH01004> day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>, upon the place<WH04725> whereof thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8804> that thou wouldest put<WH07760><WTH8800> thy name<WH08034> there; to hearken<WH08085><WTH8800> unto the prayer<WH08605> which thy servant<WH05650> prayeth<WH06419><WTH8691> toward this place<WH04725>. <RF>toward...: or, in this place<Rf>

Hearken<WH08085><WTH8804> therefore unto the supplications<WH08469> of thy servant<WH05650>, and of thy people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>, which they shall make<WH06419><WTH8691> toward this place<WH04725>: hear<WH08085><WTH8799> thou from thy dwelling<WH03427><WTH8800> place<WH04725>, <FI>even<Fi> from heaven<WH08064>; and when thou hearest<WH08085><WTH8804>, forgive<WH05545><WTH8804>. <RF>make: Heb. pray<Rf> <RF>toward...: or, in this place<Rf>

If a man<WH0376> sin<WH02398><WTH8799> against his neighbour<WH07453>, and an oath<WH0423> be laid<WH05375><WTH8804> upon him to make him swear<WH0422><WTH8687>, and the oath<WH0423> come<WH0935><WTH8804> before<WH06440> thine altar<WH04196> in this house<WH01004>; <RF>and an oath...: Heb. and he require an oath of him<Rf>

And if thy people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478> be put to the worse<WH05062><WTH8735> before<WH06440> the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, because they have sinned<WH02398><WTH8799> against thee; and shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> and confess<WH03034><WTH8689> thy name<WH08034>, and pray<WH06419><WTH8694> and make supplication<WH02603><WTH8694> before<WH06440> thee in this house<WH01004>; <RF>be put...: or, be smitten<Rf> <RF>in: or, toward<Rf>

When the heaven<WH08064> is shut up<WH06113><WTH8736>, and there is no rain<WH04306>, because they have sinned<WH02398><WTH8799> against thee; <FI>yet<Fi> if they pray<WH06419><WTH8694> toward this place<WH04725>, and confess<WH03034><WTH8689> thy name<WH08034>, and turn<WH07725><WTH8799> from their sin<WH02403>, when thou dost afflict<WH06031><WTH8686> them; <RF>toward...: or, in this place<Rf>

If there be dearth<WH07458> in the land<WH0776>, if there be pestilence<WH01698>, if there be blasting<WH07711>, or mildew<WH03420>, locusts<WH0697>, or caterpillers<WH02625>; if their enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> besiege<WH06887><WTH8686> them in the cities<WH08179> of their land<WH0776>; whatsoever sore<WH05061> or whatsoever sickness<WH04245> <FI>there be<Fi> : <RF>in the cities...: Heb. in the land of their gates<Rf>

<FI> Then<Fi> what prayer<WH08605> <FI>or<Fi> what supplication<WH08467> soever shall be made of any man<WH0120>, or of all thy people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>, when every one<WH0376> shall know<WH03045><WTH8799> his own sore<WH05061> and his own grief<WH04341>, and shall spread forth<WH06566><WTH8804> his hands<WH03709> in this house<WH01004>: <RF>in: or, toward<Rf> <RF>toward...: or, in this place<Rf>
